mismatches.question: If someone steals funds from my bank account through an unauthorized online transaction, am I covered?
mismatches.rationale: Section I (p.1) covers unauthorized-transaction theft, subject to 48-hour reporting and the deductible.

mismatches.question: If I am tricked into paying for goods online that are never delivered, am I covered?
mismatches.rationale: Section II (p.1) covers online purchase fraud subject to those conditions.

mismatches.question: If I am hit by a ransomware attack and pay a ransom to regain access to my files, am I covered?
mismatches.rationale: The insuring grants are limited to unauthorized transactions and online purchase fraud; extortion is not separately insured.

mismatches.question: If I am hacked while using my work laptop for my business and suffer a loss, am I covered?
If a war or terrorist act causes my cyber loss, am I covered?
mismatches.rationale: Exclusion 14 (p.2) excludes war / terrorism / governmental acts.

mismatches.question: Am I covered for losses caused by a power cut or internet outage at my service provider?
